title: Fausse police et rançon en anglais
notes: Conversation synthétique de test, jamais un appel réel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the police. Your son has been arrested and you must act immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Transfer the bail money right now using gift cards. Read me every card code.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not call your family or the police station. This investigation is secret.
